message: `ne::Node` contains itself through a `Vec` with no enum in between

fix.message: make the recursive part an enum, e.g. `enum Tree { Node(i64, Vec<Tree>) }` (a recursive struct of structs alone is not supported yet, ADR-0047 §3)
read through it (`v[i].len()`, `&v[i]`), take it with `pop`, or exchange it with `std::mem::replace(&mut v[i], new)`

message: `clone` of a `Vec<Vec<i64>>` is not supported yet

fix.message: its elements own memory: build the copy with a loop that pushes new values
